programmes.d: The battle between the Classic 302 SBF vs. 305 SBC continues; going head-to-head, Ford vs Chevy; keeping it simple with only one change, compression!; increasing the compression on both engines and getting them as close as possible.
Our 305 Small Block Chevy and 302 Small Block Ford return for another round of the brand loyalty war.
Pro engine tips on assembling and tuning everything from street engines to full-race motors.
Muscle Car is onto its next challenge with Project Red Sled, a 1961 Impala; the Le Mans gets finishing touches.
Reinforcing the frame on a '61 Impala.
Tackling the metalwork on a '61 Impala.
We continue on a 1969 Firebird, taking off the rusty sub-frame and modifying the Impala, known as Red Sled.
Hanging body panels on a '61 Impala.
The '61 Impala gets a 409 & 4-speed, Rick and Brent get creative with the inner fenders, and the Tribute Trans Am gets its first prime and blocking; the MuscleCar crew visits the Year One Experience.
It's three-for-one; the Tribute Trans Am, Red Sled and Altered E-Go.
The '61 Impala is back in the shop for bodywork.
Installing fuel and brake lines; visiting the Matco Tool Expo.
Red Sled gets a console.
Rebuilding a starter.
Ride along on the maiden voyage of the Red Sled.
Hosts Eric Smart and Chris Reader take you on an off-road adventure, making the off-road and overland trucks and SUVs.
We're tuning a hopped-up LQ4 engine for Dirt & Trails' 1987 Land Cruiser build.
It's an OBS Chevy K1500 4WD we converted to AWD, slammed, and LS swapped!
Brad Starks' '32 Ford Coupe: a classic hot rod rebellion packing a supercharged LT4 with 680hp!
What do you get when you cross a '53 Willys and an '84 military CUCV….one heck of an off-road mud wagon!
Engineers partner with EBC Brakes to modify a 2014 Cadillac CTS-V wagon into a vehicle capable of towing a trailer for a trade show exhibit.
Can the Blacktop Speed Shop crew turn this rare 2014 Cadillac CTS-V Wagon from a 1 of 400 ever made into a 1 of 1 unicorn for the EBC Brakes' booth at SEMA?
Transforming vehicles with performance and styling upgrades.
Our 1969 Dodge Dart, Project Bullseye, is a bare shell, providing a blank canvas; Brian shows you some easy DIY color mixing methods for pigment matching paint.
Joel and Brian install the suspension of a 1969 Dodge Dart and share tips on performing the process in safety and style.
Progress continues on Project Bullseye, a 1969 Dodge Dart, with work on suspension, wiring and paint.
With its rear axle installed, new tires mounted, and trim blacked out, our 1969 Dart is now on all fours.
Project Bullseye gets a power upgrade, brakes, steering, painted scooped hood, and Swinger stripe.
A classic C-10 is treated to air suspension on all four corners.
The classic pickup returns for custom brakes, a fuel system and cab repair.
The C10 Chevy gets treated to rust repair and a painted firewall before preparing for paint as a fully assembled truck.
The C10 Chevy gets its bed assembled, cut for exhaust exits and a new interior; the gas filler is relocated after shaving the factory hole.
Quick fixes to pass an emissions test; our C10 gets painted to look old with fauxtina treatment.
The team wraps up its classic C-10 build, then pays it off at NCM Motorsports Park.
